about_the_game:
Car Parkour X: Zozo Edition

Prepare yourself for the ultimate automotive adventure with Car Parkour X: Zozo Edition, an innovative racing game that fuses extreme parkour mechanics with high-speed driving. Designed to challenge even the most daring drivers, this game pushes the boundaries of both physics and imagination, delivering an adrenaline-fueled experience unlike anything you've ever played.

Key Features:

  • Intense Parkour Action: Navigate through meticulously crafted tracks featuring gravity-defying jumps, ramps, loops, and obstacles that will test your precision and reflexes.

  • Dynamic Vehicle Selection: Explore an expansive lineup of distinct vehicles, each with specialized performance attributes, handling dynamics, and customizable aesthetics to suit various play styles.

  • Advanced Customization: Tailor your vehicles to your exact specifications with an extensive customization system, including paint schemes, decals, performance parts, and unique visual enhancements that ensure your car stands out on every track.

  • Immersive Environments: Experience spectacular, visually captivating environments filled with intricate details and dynamic elements designed to heighten your gaming immersion and challenge your driving skills to the utmost.

  • Realistic Physics Engine: Master the complexities of realistic vehicle physics, including traction, momentum, and collision dynamics, to perform awe-inspiring stunts and flawless maneuvers.

Why Choose Car Parkour X: Zozo Edition?

Every level of Car Parkour X: Zozo Edition presents a unique challenge designed to captivate and excite. The precision controls and sophisticated driving physics ensure that each completed track feels rewarding and unforgettable. Whether you're competing against other racers online or testing your limits in single-player mode, Car Parkour X offers relentless excitement and satisfaction.

Step into the world of high-speed thrills, daring maneuvers, and ultimate competition. Prove your skills, defy the impossible, and rise to the pinnacle of automotive parkour greatness.

Feel the rush. Defy gravity. Become legendary.

  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: dedicated sound card
